_comment: Quick buy on the LOADOUT screen (DESIGN.md §16.6), read by QuickBuyTable and QuickBuy; the cards are data/quick_buy/<id>.json. bundle_discount: the share a card takes off the sum of its lines at your current trader prices (Trading.price(): loyalty first, then this, each line held at its resale floor). min_magazines: a card's rounds for a gun are at least this many of its magazines (checked), and a gun swapped in gets at least that many of its own. max_custom: custom cards (SAVE CURRENT GEAR AS QUICK-BUY) a profile keeps; name_length: their names are cut to this. penetration_drop: a round standing in for another may have this share less penetration at most, as long as one that does exists. Offers are compared with a dollar at the exchange's buy rate (data/config/trading.json). similarity: the weights of how far an alternative is from what it replaces: value (per unit of log price ratio), class (armor class), penetration and damage (rounds), cells (rig and backpack room), ergonomics (guns), capacity (magazines), uses (meds).
